definitions.gloss: child with a disability; disabled child
definitions.explanation: A child who has a physical, intellectual, or developmental disability. Used in education, welfare, and medical contexts.

examples.japanese: {障害児|しょうがいじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支援|しえん}する→支援する：25534_shiensuru⟧。
examples.english: To support the education of children with disabilities.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{障害児|しょうがいじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{入|い}れている→受け入れる：05755_ukeireru⟧。
examples.english: This school accepts children with disabilities.

examples.japanese: {障害児|しょうがいじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まって→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Parents of children with disabilities gathered to exchange information.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{障害|しょうがい}→障害：03228_shougai⟧ (disability, impairment) + {児|じ} (child). Appears in welfare and education terms such as {障害児|しょうがいじ}⟦{保育|ほいく}→保育：11461_hoiku⟧ (childcare for disabled children).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {障害児|しょうがいじ}⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧: special-needs education
- {障害児|しょうがいじ}⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧: a facility for children with disabilities

USAGE:
The spelling {障|しょう}がい{児|じ}, mixing kanji and kana, is increasingly preferred in official and considerate contexts to soften the negative connotation of the character ⟦{害|がい}→害：02542_gai⟧ (harm).
